FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 155
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Kirk Hatcher
Analyst: Cary Dean Date: 02/18/2025
Senate Bill 155 as introduced would increase the obligations of the State Comptroller's Office
by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost of any additional staff hired to process
state employee payroll deductions for certain financial instruments.
